{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABblH9Zw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhFI2eM", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 78, "title": "Upgrade @takahirox/three-mmd to published 0.1.3 and remove the temporary PMX texture-path shim", "body": "## Request and current state

The maintainer has **personally published `@takahirox/three-mmd@0.1.3` to npm**. Treat the publication as complete; do **not** leave the work blocked on a new upstream release, and do not initiate any npm publishing.

The public Uka/Gene MMD-vs-glTF demo currently pins **`@takahirox/three-mmd: "0.1.2"`** in `package.json` and `package-lock.json` (main at `3dfa726aa38992a1f7d5ea17b377c685e839e8b8`). Issue #73 / PR #74 implemented and tested a temporary compatibility layer because the older published 0.1.2 loader concatenated raw PMX Windows-style texture names (notably the real Uka entry `tex\\hair_s01.png`) into resource URLs without canonicalization.

The upstream source fix is merged in [three-mmd-loader PR #107](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/107) / [Issue #106](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/106). [PR #111](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/111) prepared the new 0.1.3 release candidate. **This issue performs the downstream migration now that the maintainer reports publication.**

### Goal

Use **the actual npm-published 0.1.3 package** directly, remove obsolete local path-resolution workarounds, and preserve canonical PMX texture requests, browser error handling and the existing Uka/Gene demo.

**Scope/workflow:** Task for the designated implementer. The issue author is not implementing code, creating branches or opening PRs. Do not alter the upstream library or publish packages.

## Specific repository touch points

- [`package.json`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/package.json) and [`package-lock.json`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/package-lock.json): currently exact 0.1.2.
- [`examples/main.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/main.ts): currently imports `createMMDLoader` from `./mmd-loader-compat` and calls `createMMDLoader(manager).loadAsync(...)` for direct PMX; animation loading uses `new MMDLoader().loadAnimation(...)`. Replace the model-loading compatibility factory with normal library `new MMDLoader(manager)` while preserving `LoadingManager` status/error/Retry behavior.
- [`examples/mmd-loader-compat.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/mmd-loader-compat.ts): scoped 0.1.2-only wrapper for MaterialBuilder, PMD sphere map aliases, TGA decoder/handler ordering; remove when direct packaged behavior is verified.
- [`packages/mmd-resource-path.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/packages/mmd-resource-path.ts): duplicate temporary resolver; delete if no independent consumers require it.
- [`patches/three-mmd-loader-resource-path.patch`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/patches/three-mmd-loader-resource-path.patch): historical candidate upstream patch; avoid leaving active instructions suggesting the obsolete 0.1.2 patch must be applied. Remove the stale patch (or relocate it to explicitly archival evidence only if project policy requires).
- [`tests/mmd-resource-path.test.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tests/mmd-resource-path.test.ts) and [`tests/browser/mmd-resource-path.spec.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tests/browser/mmd-resource-path.spec.ts) currently import the shim/local resolver and assert their implementation details. **Retain/rework the behavioral tests to drive the real installed `MMDLoader` 0.1.3**, rather than simply deleting those tests because the shim was removed. Avoid deep imports into unpublished package internals.
- [`tests/browser/uka.spec.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tests/browser/uka.spec.ts) already tests pinned Uka cold/warm loads, actual hair request paths and failed-image Retry; keep these regressions.
- [`docs/pmx-resource-paths.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/pmx-resource-paths.md) currently describes awaiting a corrected npm release and the temporary shim; update it to document the real 0.1.3 integration, with original incident and upstream history preserved accurately.

## Implementation

### 1. Integrate the published release

- [ ] Confirm the actual `@takahirox/three-mmd@0.1.3` distribution from the **official npm registry**, its `version`, `dist.integrity`, `gitHead`/provenance where available, exports, and that the **installed tarball** contains the upstream PMD/PMX texture-resource path fix (not merely the upstream GitHub `main` source). This is a verification step, **not a reason to ignore the maintainer's confirmed publication**. If the tarball unexpectedly differs from the verified source, report concrete evidence rather than silently downgrading or adding another workaround.
- [ ] Update `package.json` to exactly `0.1.3`; regenerate/update the lockfile normally and confirm `node_modules/@takahirox/three-mmd` resolves to 0.1.3 after a clean `npm ci`. Preserve other dependency pins and avoid incidental updates.
- [ ] Use the standard 0.1.3 `MMDLoader` for the public direct-PMX load. Remove `createMMDLoader` and local resolver/shim code no longer needed, including obsolete build imports, test-only fixture imports, and temporary patch wiring. No `node_modules` edits, monkey patches or hidden reimplementation of the same resolver.
- [ ] Confirm the upstream package's PMD base/sphere role classification, relative path canonicalization, custom/default toon, TGA URL handling, query/fragment and encoded filenames, handler/cache ordering and failed-cache callbacks work in the **actual downstream build**. Preserve the original PMX/PMD names and licensed bytes.

### 2. Preserve and adapt test coverage

- [ ] Rework existing Node and Playwright resource-path tests so they test **observable output of the real 0.1.3 loader**: mixed Windows/POSIX separators, safe dot segments, UTF-8/spaces/percent escapes, traversal rejection, PMX base/sphere/subtexture/toon, PMD sphere URL queries/fragments, TGA decoder selection, cache identity, and useful error semantics. Do not rely on the now-deleted `mmd-loader-compat.ts` endpoint or assert old shim internals.
- [ ] In the real pinned Uka scenario, verify the original raw entry `tex\\hair_s01.png` remains intact, while actual **PMX-side network requests** resolve to `/mmd-gltf/uka/tex/hair_s01.png` with no `\\` or `%5C` and HTTP 200, decoded images, and both pane statuses Ready. Verify warm/cold cache and original filename preservation. Also test Gene Light.
- [ ] Verify Uka/Gene both still render with correct texture/toon/outline, PBR fallback, synchronized camera, three embedded VMD animations, motion switching without model reload, IK On/Off and Gene grant-dependent IK. **Open Issue #77** separately requests public Physics On/Off; don't bundle that feature into this dependency update or break its branch/workflow.
- [ ] Preserve visible failures and Retry for deliberate texture 404, corrupt image with HTTP 200, request failure and unsafe local names; errors should distinguish network/decode/path problems, not misreport them as successful normalization.
- [ ] Run `npm ci`, `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, relevant `npm run test:browser` suites (resource paths, Uka, Gene, motion/IK and unified demo), `npm run check:links`, and `git diff --check`. Record actual pass/fail/skip and JS/browser versions; existing unrelated long conformance suites need not be silently claimed as run.

### 3. Documentation and Android acceptance

- [ ] Update README/docs and linked validation results so they state: **0.1.3 published and consumed**, temporary 0.1.2 compatibility shim removed, upstream fix in #106/#107, historical incident in downstream #73/#74, while keeping source rights, license and provenance accurate.
- [ ] Perform actual Android Chrome cold-cache and warm-cache tests if a device is available (model, Android and Chrome versions, deployed commit, canonical hair request, HTTP status, image decode result, both panes Ready). Exercise representative VMD, IK, model switch, Toon/PBR, Outline and retry. **Desktop/mobile emulation alone is not proof of Android compatibility.**
- [ ] If Android still fails with correct request URLs, investigate image decode/CPU/RAM/GPU/resource exhaustion as a distinct cause; retain the user's original problem report instead of claiming the path change proved an Android fix. Uka hair image is about 12.3 MB compressed and initial Uka preview loads are resource-heavy.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The deployed app is built from the real npm package **`@takahirox/three-mmd@0.1.3`**, with exact matching manifest/lockfile and a clean `npm ci`.
- [ ] Direct-PMX model loading uses **ordinary upstream `MMDLoader`** rather than `createMMDLoader`; no active local resolver/compatibility shim remains. Historical patch/docs do not claim ongoing necessity.
- [ ] Regression tests now target the real dependency and show the Uka hair request path is canonical, decode/HTTP success and failure/Retry remain correct, and no security/encoding/PMD/TGA regression is introduced.
- [ ] Existing Uka/Gene public appearance, asset provenance, MMD-vs-glTF animation synchronization, IK controls, resource reuse, mobile layout and access to original files remain intact.
- [ ] Required automated checks pass with documented results; where a physical Android browser is unavailable, **Android-specific verification remains explicitly pending** rather than being marked complete solely from desktop CI.

## Related

- [mmd-gltf #73](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/issues/73), [PR #74](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/pull/74): temporary compatibility integration and source/image regression tests.
- [three-mmd-loader #106](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/106), [PR #107](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/107): upstream normalization fix.
- [three-mmd-loader #110](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/110), [PR #111](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/111): 0.1.3 release preparation.
- [mmd-gltf #77](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/issues/77): separate Physics toggle feature.

## Required post-merge verification

Confirm the merge-triggered build/Pages deployment of this updated dependency (exact SHA), check the live app's Uka texture request and both Ready states, and perform actual Android Chrome verification if available. If Android is not accessible, leave that last item pending with the explicit manual steps in `docs/pmx-resource-paths.md`.
